messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — the nightly docs-scan flagged ~12 404s under /runtime/api/examples. Most are curl snippets pointing to old gist/raw links. Not blocking, but we should do a quick triage and small PR. @liam any chance you can take this? :eyes:
docbot: [automated scan] Found 12 dead links in /runtime/api/examples. Report: https://internal.reports/docs-scan/1712348888 — examples/curl/ uses gist.github.com raw URLs which 404 now.
liam: I can take first pass tonight. Will ripgrep for gist.github.com and replace with raw.githubusercontent when possible.
maria: thanks — if you want a quick sed to update raw urls: ```bash
rg "gist.github.com/.*/raw" -l | xargs -n1 sed -i "s|https://gist.github.com/.*/raw/|https://raw.githubusercontent.com/|g"
```
liam: nice — will run locally and open a small PR. I'll also add a tiny link-check unit to the docs CI for that folder so it doesn't slip again.
jess: FYI linkcheck in docs CI is currently set to WARN, so it didn't block the build. If you're adding a test pls make it non-flaky (timeout + allowlist). I can help with the CI tweak.
tina: if you want faster ownership, ping @docs-maintainers or add frontmatter `owners` so we can auto-assign in the sweep.
liam: good idea. I'll add frontmatter owners: `- docs/runtime` to the files I change. PR will be "docs: fix runtime example gist links + owners" and I'll ping reviewers.
alok: I'll review tomorrow morning — please tag me in the PR. Quick reminder: update any inline code samples that reference the old gist filename changes, not just the base URL.
maria: also add a note in the changelog section of the runtime guide (one line) so support can track the user-facing examples that changed.
liam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4021 — fixes 8 files, owners added. cc @jess @maria @alok :pray:
jess: skimmed — small nit in one curl example (missing `-sS`). Left a 1-line comment, otherwise LGTM.
liam: fixed and pushed. Tests (local linkcheck) passed.
jess: LGTM, merging now :shipit:
docbot: [deploy] docs staging site rebuild queued (job 8871). Will post status when finished.
maria: thanks everyone — if any broken snippets left, please flag in #docs and we'll pick them up in the next sweep.
